Recipes for solving a specific task. Each page assumes you already know the basics — see [Learn](../learn/index.qmd) if you are just starting.

## Recipes

### Searching & validating

- [Search with misspellings](search-misspellings.qmd) — fuzzy search tuning, thresholds, `match_hooks`, admin-level scoping.
- [Validate addresses](validate-addresses.qmd) — `validate()` / `validate_many()`, thresholds, batch validation.

### Exporting & transforming

- [Export to CSV / pandas](export-to-csv-pandas.qmd) — `to_frame()` / `to_dicts()`, CLI export, model selection.

### Navigating the hierarchy

- [Traverse the hierarchy](traverse-hierarchy.qmd) — parent / children / ancestors, get-by-region / province.

### Time & enrichment

- [Work with historical data](work-with-historical-data.qmd) — `use_version`, `as_of`, `resolve_date`.
- [Enrich with plugins](enrich-with-plugins.qmd) — `psgc-aux-data`, `--plugin`, `PluginLoader`.

### Automation

- [Geocode batch files](geocode-batch-files.qmd) — CLI `batch-search` / `batch validate` from files.

### Migration

- [Migrate from the legacy API](migrate-from-legacy-api.qmd) — consolidate `search()` / `BARANGAY` dict usage onto the Database API.
